Sourav Sinha

Phone: +91 6309678248 | Email: souravsinha.agt@outlook.com | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/sourav-sinha-211088216

Professional Summary

Data Scientist / AI-ML Engineer with 6+ years of experience in Data Science and Machine Learning, and 9 years overall professional experience. Expertise in NLP, Predictive Modeling, Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Cloud Deployment (Azure). Skilled in Python, SQL, EDA, Feature Engineering, and Statistical Analysis. Adept at leveraging TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) to deliver insights, optimize operations, and enhance decision-making.

Skills

Python | SQL | Machine Learning | NLP (Natural Language Processing) | Text Mining | Statistical Modelling | Predictive Analytics | Data Analytics | Power BI | Tableau | Azure Cloud | Git | Data Visualization | Risk Management | Stakeholder Management | Deep Learning | TensorFlow | PyTorch | scikit-learn | Transformers | Large Language Models (LLMs) | MLOps | Model Deployment | Docker | Kubernetes | Hugging Face

Professional Experience

JP Morgan Chase, Hyderabad, Telangana

Control Manager | Jan 2024 – Present

Analyzed large datasets to identify and mitigate 52 regulatory risks for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) in a European country.
• Implemented fuzzy matching and NLP-based semantic search techniques to improve accuracy in PEP identification.
• Conducted re-performance testing, uncovering 16 previously unnoticed risks, strengthening compliance.
• Built NLP-based semantic similarity models (spaCy) for business description alignment with NAIC codes.
• Automated risk identification and reporting processes with Python, improving compliance efficiency.

Accenture India Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru, Karnataka

Senior Data Scientist | Jun 2022 – Jan 2024



Designed ML classifiers for categorizing survey verbatims, boosting customer satisfaction and productivity.
• Performed sentiment analysis on call transcripts, generating actionable insights for strategy.
• Developed Power BI dashboards for KPIs and deployed AHT dashboards on Azure Cloud.
• Built text mining, topic modeling, and clustering solutions to drive operational decision-making.
• Partnered with stakeholders to design prototypes for Customer-Ops Experience Layer.

Genpact India Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, Telangana

Data Scientist | Jul 2019 – May 2022

Led NLP project for product categorization based on descriptions.
• Conducted real TAT analysis using Salesforce data, improving turnaround times.
• Created Tableau dashboards for supplier performance, process KPIs, and error tracking.
• Designed and implemented scorecards and trackers to support procurement operations.

Jeevan Polymers Pvt Ltd, Hyderabad, Telangana

Assistant General Manager | Mar 2018 – Jun 2019

Managed INR 52 Cr annual raw material purchases with end-to-end SCM oversight.
• Achieved INR 8–9 L cost savings via process improvements and negotiation.
• Reduced logistics costs by 5% through strategic supplier partnerships.

Gopal Corporation Ltd, Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu

QA/QC and Dispatch Manager | Nov 2016 – Feb 2018

Oversaw quality control and dispatch operations for raw ingredients and finished goods.
• Maintained compliance with quality system guidelines.

Sietz India Pvt Ltd

Production Supervisor | Jul 2016 – Oct 2016

Directed chemical production operations, ensuring consistent product quality.

Education

B.Tech in Chemical Engineering | Priyadarshini Institute of Engineering & Technology, Nagpur | 2015
12th | Boardowali H/S School, Agartala, TBSE | 2008
10th | Boardowali H/S School, Agartala, TBSE | 2006



Certifications

Data Science & Machine Learning – Jigsaw Academy
• Data Visualization (Tableau) – Jigsaw Academy

Projects

Bank Term Deposit Predictive Analytics – Data wrangling, EDA, feature engineering, statistical analysis, model building, hyperparameter tuning.
• CSAT Analysis – End-to-end ML pipeline with visualization in Power BI and deployment on Azure Cloud.

Additional Information

Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Manipuri, Assamese
